records: CoinDesk's PoR review identifies Binance 14 as an Ethereum wallet; it does not establish membership of any of the five Binance-labelled XRPL source wallets.

Binance's official PoR page exposes a Download All Address control, but the underlying address export was not retrieved through the browser-readable page; the official XRP crosswalk remains unresolved.
Binance's USD6.3B impact and USD3B frozen figures are company/analytics estimates; frozen is not recovered, and no XRP-specific replenishment amount is disclosed.
Alpha Finance's XRP OI/liquidation panel is a single-provider aggregate; contract coverage is not reconciled with Liqwall, and heatmap levels are modelled rather than executable order-book liquidity.
XRP Insights ETF flows are holdings deltas with excluded/reconstructed rows and BITW/ETF-of-ETF exposure; they are not equivalent to direct same-window spot purchases.
October 26-29 ETF flows predate the first identified October 29 20:05 UTC Binance XRP transfer and cannot be attributed as a response to it.
The attacker XRP receiver was last captured in prior research at 07:23 UTC with no outgoing XRP payment; this run did not refresh its balance, so later disposition remains unknown.
PR #1379 passed exact-head core CI and fail-closed gate but remains draft and unmerged; the two scheduled main-writing workflows remain active until an approved merge.
Full repository CI and dependency vulnerability scanning were not run; passing PR core CI does not replace those checks.
Only GitHub access and handoff were tested; the other eight target platforms remain unauthenticated/unverified as live collaborators.
